bugs.title: Valve reopens too slowly after lockout release
bugs.description: The valve state is only recomputed inside the 40 ms tick block (lines 55-74), and the lockout branch at lines 62-65 forces the valve closed while D3 is LOW. After release, reopening depends on the next tick where tempC is still below FIRE_ON_C, but the measured evidence shows D6 was not HIGH for 319 ms and 860 ms respectively, exceeding the 500 ms grace in the second case. The firmware does not latch or immediately re-evaluate on lockout release, so the reopen is delayed beyond the required 500 ms window. D6 was in the wrong state for 319 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 2.00 s: D6 was not HIGH for 319 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

bugs.title: Lockout key not debounced and polled only every 40 ms
bugs.description: D3 is read directly with digitalRead at line 59 with no debounce, and only once per 40 ms tick (line 55). Short 60 ms presses and contact bounce are therefore sampled inconsistently, and the measured evidence shows D6 not HIGH for 500-940 ms across multiple intervals in the short-press and bounce scenarios. The lockout state is also not held or filtered, so brief LOW glitches and missed presses cause the valve to stay closed longer than the 500 ms allowance. D6 was in the wrong state for 2520 ms across 25 interval(s), first at 560 ms: D6 was not HIGH for 121 ms while required (grace 500 ms).
